archetypes.name: lifecycle-parity
archetypes.rationale: Step 0/1 bash parity is the highest-risk migration surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new design_lifecycle Step 0/1 verbs against the retired wrapper contracts. Focus on stdout KVs, pause-save terminal boundaries, route/init result capture, degraded-tools relay, and brainstorm dirty-tree handling. Call out any behavior drift that could break prompt-side orchestration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-cutover
archetypes.rationale: The PID launcher now mixes Python verbs with legacy shell basenames.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review session_env launcher generation, SKILL fences, and structural tests together. Verify all ported Step 0/1 calls use bare verbs, all unported clarify and Step 2+ calls still use .sh basenames, and unsafe or retired tokens fail closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-coverage
archetypes.rationale: This change deletes many scripts and replaces shell harness coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review deleted script coverage, migrated-scripts entries, Makefile targets, checks routing, and scripts/test-design-structure.sh. Focus on whether important retired-shell contracts remain pinned by pytest or structural assertions without preserving stale references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
